Branch

Care

Destinations

The Medical Mission, Women to Women and Senior Living, with the Ramallah Foundation and the Endowed Fund shown as funds that people give to and cannot join. People arrive by choice or by capacity to give, never by progression.

Programmes on this branch

Medical Mission

Volunteer physicians, specialists and health professionals from the US and Palestine building long-term health capacity in Palestine: prosthetics, eye and cancer screening, hospital equipment and workforce training.

Designed Flagship Mission
Women to Women

Direct financial help to women in Ramallah and their families for basic needs and self-improvement. Projects are proposed in writing from Ramallah and approved by a committee.

Plan only Committee
Senior Living Project

A capital project for a new senior residence in Ramallah, replacing a 1970s facility: about 30,000 square feet for 50 or more residents. Ground was broken in October 2023 and the cornerstone laid in June 2024.

Designed Campaign

How people move along it

Destinations. People arrive by choice or by capacity to give. The Ramallah Foundation and the Endowed Fund are funds: shown here, not joined. Inside every programme, people move through the same five rungs: hear · show up · take part · give or serve · lead (D25).
